intent summary (test name): auto queue runs independent tasks past review and during planning
decision: Keep; high-cost queue acceptance E2E
evidence / review status: One scenario covers two concurrent implementation slots; planning chat during execution; dependency blocking while unrelated work proceeds; capacity waiting; retry after remote divergence; approval gates; publication integrity; and persisted queue cleanup. It uses a single local Git fixture and fake provider. The UI loop polls every 20 ms until the workflow completes; the fake provider adds a 300 ms execution delay and waits up to 45 seconds for the unrelated task to start before completing planning. Those waits contribute to elapsed time and should be profiled before any reduction. No other reviewed test covers these combined UI-to-queue invariants.
